subject: general
question:
Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.

There was very poor receptivity due from technological glitches; nonetheless, the online class was continued.
solution:
The erroneous part is **'due from technological glitches'. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the error lies in using the phrase **due from **to modify the **noun phrase technological glitches.**
